profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer, Senior at Jack Henry
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer who thrives on solving hard problems. For more than 20 years in financial technology, I’ve built a career around diving into complexity — the kind of systems, bugs, integrations, and architectural challenges that require patience, pattern recognition, and a true love of technical problem‑solving. That’s the work that energizes me, and it’s where I bring the most value.

I’m at home in environments where the challenges are intricate and the expectations are high. Whether designing microservices in .NET Core, modernizing legacy platforms, refining CI/CD pipelines, or debugging behavior that isn’t obvious to anyone else, I’m motivated by the process of understanding the root cause, simplifying what’s over‑complicated, and building solutions that last. I think systematically and execute pragmatically, balancing long‑term architecture with the realities of day‑to‑day engineering.

Collaboration is important, but solving problems is where I do my best work. I naturally gravitate toward the issues others escalate, the logic that isn’t adding up, or the pieces of a system that don’t quite fit together yet. Bringing clarity, structure, and direction to technical ambiguity is something I genuinely enjoy, and I take pride in being someone teams can rely on when things get difficult.

I’m also committed to continuous learning. Becoming Generative AI Certified has opened new ways of thinking about how AI can support engineering workflows, accelerate analysis, and make root‑cause identification and solution design even more efficient. I enjoy applying these insights to improve the way teams build, debug, and deliver software.

At my core, I’m someone who loves the craft: understanding how things work, improving them, and solving problems that matter. I bring focus, precision, and a solution‑oriented mindset to every challenge — and I show up every day ready to tackle the next big technical puzzle.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - Jack Henry Origination
positions.description:
As a Staff Software Engineer on the Jack Henry Origination team, I provide technical leadership and architectural guidance for the modernization of the Origination platform. I lead the design and development of scalable, cloud‑native microservices and RESTful APIs in .NET Core/C#, ensuring reliability, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise engineering standards.

*   Lead the **architecture, design, and development** of distributed microservices and RESTful APIs using .NET Core/C#.
*   Drive the **transition from monolithic applications to service‑based architectures**, defining patterns and boundaries across domains.
*   Architect and support **multi‑tenant microservices** using Docker containerization and orchestration through **Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)**.
*   Guide **infrastructure automation strategies** using Terraform to enable repeatable, scalable deployments.
*   **Refine and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows** to support reliable, scalable delivery of microservices.
*   Establish coding standards, architectural guidelines, and best practices for microservices, API design, and cloud‑native development.
*   Serve as a technical escalation point, assisting teams with complex design challenges, performance concerns, and production issues.
*   Collaborate with Product, Architecture, QA, and Support teams to ensure solutions align with business objectives and customer needs.
*   Contribute to planning and execution within the **SAFe Agile** framework, influencing program increments, sprint objectives, and long‑term technical direction.
*   Deliver high‑quality, maintainable code grounded in **SOLID principles**, cloud‑native best practices, and engineering discipline.
positions.insights: Software Engineering Practices, Generative AI and +17 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Jack Henry Origination
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer on the Jack Henry Origination team, I design and build scalable microservices and RESTful APIs using .NET Core and C#. I contribute to modernizing the Origination platform by migrating monolithic applications into cloud‑ready, multi‑tenant microservices that support financial institutions nationwide.

*   Develop and maintain **RESTful microservices** in .NET Core/C#, supporting the Origination product ecosystem.
*   Contribute to the **migration of monolithic systems** into distributed, service‑based architectures across assigned business domains.
*   Assist with **architecture and solution design** for multi‑tenant microservices leveraging Docker containers and orchestration via **Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)**.
*   Support **infrastructure automation initiatives** using **Terraform**, improving repeatability, scalability, and cloud deployment efficiency.
*   Collaborate on **DevOps workflows** for composing, providing, and reusing infrastructure as code.
*   Participate in technical design discussions and help shape standards for microservices architecture, API design, and cloud‑native development.
*   Develop software within the **SAFe Agile framework**, contributing to program increments, sprints, planning, and iterative delivery.
*   Deliver high‑quality, maintainable code following **SOLID principles** and established engineering best practices.
*   Partner with cross‑functional teams—including Architecture, DevOps, QA, and Product—to deliver secure, reliable, and high‑performing services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Onboard Deposits
positions.description:
Develop and enhance the WPF/MEF‑based OnBoard Deposits application supporting onboarding for checking, savings, and tax‑advantaged accounts. I collaborate closely with BA, QA, Support, and Operations teams to deliver new features, resolve issues, and prioritize hotfixes with fast turnaround. I manage build delivery, code rollouts, and performance benchmarks for each release while improving workflows and team processes. I also contribute to technical solutions across Deposits and Loans, delivering SOLID‑aligned code within an Agile Scrum environment.

*   Develop, maintain, and enhance WPF/MEF components and workflows within the OnBoard Deposits platform.
*   Support onboarding functionality for checking, savings, and tax‑advantaged deposit accounts.
*   Collaborate cross‑functionally with BA, QA, Support, and Operations to refine requirements, troubleshoot issues, and ensure smooth releases.
*   Prioritize and deliver **hotfixes** and high‑urgency production issues with quick turnaround.
*   Manage build delivery schedules, code rollouts, and performance benchmarking for each release.
*   Identify and implement workflow and process improvements that increase team efficiency and product quality.
*   Contribute to feature design and implementation across Deposits and Loans domains.
*   Deliver clean, maintainable code aligned with **SOLID principles** and engineering best practices.
*   Participate in Agile Scrum ceremonies, supporting iterative development and timely sprint delivery.
*   Provide technical support for development and support teams, assisting with troubleshooting, defect resolution, and operational inquiries.

positions.title: Application Analyst
positions.description:
•Maintain custom applications for MS SharePoint Intranet and Extranet portal. The intranet consists of over 1500 team sites used by Bass Pro Employee Groups, i.e. Bass Pro Shops, Tracker and Big Cedar Lodge. The Extranet consists of 20 team sites used by Bass Pro Vendors, Contractors and business partners.
•Collaborated with end users to analyze and gather requirements, design and develop custom application to replace manual business processes with custom automated processes and workflows utilizing Visual Studio.Net, SharePoint Framework, Asp.Net webpart and C# technologies. 
•Design and Develop Asp.Net web applications for internet utilizing Asp.Net, JavaScript and xml technologies, ex. http://owincentives.com.
•Design and Develop SQL database objects, tables, views, queries and stored procedures to be utilized by custom applications. 
•Report creation utilizing SQL Reporting Services to convert existing Access Database Reports published on the extranet portal for vendors and contractors.
•Consistently exceed required project specifications, anticipates and handles project problems proficiently.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
*Company was acquired by Avatar Systems in 2006. http://avatarsystems.net/ Previous Owner was Jean Junker
•Develop, design, and analyze software to convert from existing DOS applications to Windows based, new program specifications and client enhancements to applications.
•Develop and design customizable report & query tool for extracting data from the application to utilize on various reports for lease and land management module using SQL queries.
•Collaborated with customer support and meet with clients to create and resolve application errors and enhancements.

positions.title: IT Asset Management Assistant/Software Manager
positions.description:
•Managed computer hardware/software assets, maintained inventory, researched and analyzed products & pricing, purchased & acquisitioned products, received and distributed inventory, issued warranties.
•Served as liaison between Mercy & vendors negotiating prices and contracts.
•Established and implemented Software Asset Management Plan; including developing Access databases, application and queries to track software licenses, installations and media.
•Created policies and procedures to ensure compliance with software license agreements and contracts.
•Developed and created inventory reports utilizing various report & query tools such as Crystal Reports.
